request: 把这个视频目录批量导入视频库，只登记元数据，不做内容检测。

Load video-embedding-index, extract representative frames locally, submit them as inline images to StreetModel, aggregate the image vectors, and enrich the source video document in place.   "index": "citybrain-video-library",

      "description": "可选的视频描述",
      "tags": ["可选标签"]
    }
  ]
}
